Tell me what you want to do in the viewport (view/camera, reference slices, colors, background, picking, axes, soma size, screenshot, animation). One sentence is enough—for example: “Enable neuron picking.”

To adjust the view, just tell me what you want in plain language. For example:
- “Switch to a side view.” / “Switch to a front view.” / “Switch to a top-down view.”
- “Rotate the camera 90° to the right/left.”
- “Tilt the camera up/down 90°.”
- “Roll the view clockwise/counterclockwise 90°.”
- “Mirror the view left↔right.” / “Flip the view vertically.”
- “Zoom in.” / “Zoom out.”
Reply with one sentence, e.g., “Rotate the camera 90° to the right.”

To change colors, tell me whether you want to color **neurons** or **brain regions**, and the style you prefer:
- Neurons: “color by brain region / by structure / by mouse line / randomly”
- Brain regions: “use Allen atlas colors / use the CEBSIT palette / random colors”
Example: “Color neurons by brain region.”

Background: say “Set the background to white / light gray / gray / dark gray / black”, or provide a hex color like “#FFFFFF”.

If you want to click/select things in the scene, tell me which picking mode and whether to turn it on or off:
- “Enable region picking.” / “Disable region picking.”
- “Enable neuron picking.” / “Disable neuron picking.”

Screenshot: just say “Take a screenshot.” (If you want the view adjusted first, tell me the camera/background change, then say “Take a screenshot.”)
